1.title: With Hopes High for New H.I.V. Prevention Pill, Merck Takes Steps to Ensure Access
1.summary: Companies in Africa and India will make generic versions of the pill that could cost as little as $5 per person per year. But access to the drug and other new products in much of Latin America remains uncertain.

2.title: Teen Charged in Georgia School Shooting Changes Plea to Guilty
2.summary: Colt Gray, 16, had been scheduled to go on trial in October. His change of plea took place at a hearing that pivoted immediately to sentencing.

3.title: Nolan Wells’ Death Rattles Black Parents About All-White Spaces
3.summary: The death of Nolan Wells after he boated with friends to an island party on July 4 has sparked anguish among Black parents about the safety of their children in predominantly white spaces.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: Strikes Persist After Iran Is Said to Reject U.S. Proposal
4.summary: American forces conducted another round of attacks on Iran, which launched drone strikes at U.S. targets in the Gulf. Iran was said to have rejected a cease-fire proposal from President Trump.

5.title: Tens of thousands evacuated from French tourist spot and near Madrid as wildfires spread
5.summary: The fire has raged in the region for several days with officials now ordering the evacuation of the entire Cap Ferret peninsula.

6.title: As Canada Opens Gordie Howe International Bridge, Americans Are Told to Stay Home
6.summary: After a delay ordered by President Trump and new tariffs against Canada, the bridge between Windsor, Ontario, and Detroit opens in “underwhelming” fashion on Friday.
